overview.label: Overview
overview.value: IoBM's College of Computer Science & Information Systems lists undergraduate BS Data Science, BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering and BS Computer Engineering. MS Artificial Intelligence is listed; a BS Artificial Intelligence link was not in that undergraduate list.

programs.label: UG programmes
programs.value: College of Computer Science & Information Systems undergraduate list: BS Data Science, BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering, BS Computer Engineering, BS Mathematics and Economics, BS Statistics & Business Analytics, BS Mathematics and Computational Finance, BS Actuarial Science and Risk Management, BS Technology Management. Other colleges list BBA and further BS programmes.

admissions.label: Eligibility
admissions.value: For BS Computer Science, BS Data Science, BS Computer Engineering and BS Software Engineering, the undergraduate requirements page says students who studied Mathematics at HSSC are eligible regardless of subject combination, and Pre-Medical students must complete two additional Mathematics courses (6 credit hours) in the first year. A separate paragraph states that an HSC/A-level or IBCC equivalent with at least 55% marks (or 2C in A-Levels) and Mathematics is the basic eligibility for the programmes that paragraph refers to.
admissions.note: The page has more than one eligibility block. Both sentences above are on https://iobm.edu.pk/undergraduate-requirements/.

admissions.label: Admission test
admissions.value: Success in the IoBM aptitude test and a panel interview. The page also describes an SAT-1 exemption from the aptitude test.
admissions.note: SAT-1 score thresholds were not copied because the exemption paragraph in the extract did not include the numeric cutoff.

admissions.label: Application fee
admissions.value: An aptitude test fee of Rs. 3,000/- to collect the admit card.

admissions.label: Intake dates
admissions.note: Admissions home was opened. A dated intake deadline was not in the extracted text. The admission-schedule URL was not opened.

fees.label: Tuition
fees.value: Visible bachelor table (no academic-year label; marked subject to change): registration fee 10,000.00; tuition per course 29,400.00; per credit hour 9,800.00; full-load tuition 176,400.00; total fee per semester 186,400.00. Additional lab charges for BS Computer Science and BS Software Engineering: Rs. 58,800.00. One-time admission fee Rs. 50,000, non-refundable and non-transferable. Sindh Sales Tax 3% on total annual fee exceeding Rs. 500,000, effective 1 July 2024, under Tariff Heading 9857.0000.
fees.note: A second bachelor table (per credit hour 8,910.00 and lab charges Rs. 44,160.00) sits in an Elementor container with elementor-hidden-desktop, tablet, mobile and widescreen. Those figures were not used.

scholarships.label: Scholarships
scholarships.value: Merit scholarships of 50% of tuition, renewed the next semester subject to the stated GPA criteria. Sports scholarships of 50% of tuition after HoD Sports endorsement. A CSR scheme admits less privileged students from districts of Sindh with a 100% fee waiver including free transportation, once a year for the Spring semester. TCF alumni are offered a 100% fee waiver including free transportation under an MoU.
scholarships.note: Amounts for Lucky Cement and Mitsubishi Corporation scholarships were not stated on the page.

facilities.label: Hostel
facilities.note: Not stated on the fee, requirements, scholarship or admissions-home pages opened 2026-10-23.

facilities.label: Transport
facilities.note: Free transportation is stated only as part of the CSR and TCF scholarship waivers, not as a general campus transport fee or route list.
